blocks.text: Following the release of his new album Do That Again, out now via Columbia Records, Malcolm Todd announces his 2026 Asia Tour. The tour promoted by Live Nation, kicks off November 23nd in Taipei, and will bring Malcolm’s high-energy live show to his biggest venues to date across Asia, including Manila on November 27 at the New Frontier Theater, Tokyo, Singapore, Seoul, Bangkok, and culminating in Kuala Lumpur on December 9. Do That Again is taking over streaming platforms, with all 13 tracks from the album hitting the U.S. Spotify Chart this week while the project rises to #5 on the […]...
